mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id , r.fair_id , r.user_id , r.reservation_type , r.status AS reservation_status , r.visit_date , fd.entry_start_time , fd.entry_end_time FROM reservations r JOIN fair_dates fd ON fd.fair_id = r.fair_id AND fd.operation_date = r.visit_date WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT eq.entry_qr_id , r.reservation_id , r.fair_id , r.user_id , r.reservation_type , r.status AS reservation_status , eq.available_from , eq.expires_at , er.entry_record_id , er.first_checked_in_at FROM entry_qrs eq JOIN reservations r ON r.reservation_id = eq.reservation_id LEFT JOIN entry_records er ON er.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE eq.token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_histories ( reservation_id , action_type , before_data , after_data , changed_by , actor_type , is_admin_action , change_reason , created_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationId} , 'CHECKED_IN' , JSON_OBJECT('status', 'CONFIRMED') , JSON_OBJECT('status', 'CHECKED_IN') , #{processedBy} , 'ADMIN' , TRUE , NULL , #{now} )
